# Budlee AI

> Budlee AI is an AI-powered personalized educational platform and tutoring companion for students in Grades 6–10.

## Overview
Budlee AI combines conversational voice tutoring, interactive problem-solving, and syllabus-aligned learning paths. It specifically supports CBSE and Indian State Boards (Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Gujarat) focusing on Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) and Mathematics.

## Key Offerings & Capabilities
- **AI Voice Tutor**: Conversational, step-by-step tutoring that explains complex concepts without just giving away answers.
- **CBSE & State Board Curriculum Alignment**: Chapter-by-chapter mapping for grades 6 through 10 in Science and Mathematics.
- **Curiosity Quests & Practice**: Active practice problems with instant feedback, hints, and mastery tracking.
- **School & Partner Portals**: Analytics dashboards for schools, tuition centers, and educators to track student learning progress.
- **Parental Visibility**: Meaningful insights into student curiosity, understanding, and learning consistency.
